package violations

// Classify nests branches past the cognitive-complexity limit.
func Classify(xs []int) int { // want: gocognit
	total := 0
	for _, x := range xs {
		if x > 0 {
			for i := range x {
				if i%2 == 0 {
					if i > 10 {
						total += i
					}
				} else {
					total--
				}
			}
		} else {
			if x%2 == 0 && x%3 == 0 {
				if x < -10 || x > -5 {
					total *= 2
				}
			}
			total--
		}
	}
	return total
}

// SumEven and SumOdd are the same code with different names.
func SumEven(xs []int) int { // want: dupl
	total, count := 0, 0
	for i, x := range xs {
		if x%2 == 0 && i >= 0 {
			total += x * 2
			count++
		} else {
			total -= x + 1
		}
		if total > 1000 {
			total = 1000
		}
	}
	if count == 0 {
		return -1
	}
	return total / count
}

// SumOdd duplicates SumEven.
func SumOdd(ys []int) int { // want: dupl
	sum, n := 0, 0
	for j, y := range ys {
		if y%2 == 1 && j >= 0 {
			sum += y * 3
			n++
		} else {
			sum -= y + 2
		}
		if sum > 2000 {
			sum = 2000
		}
	}
	if n == 0 {
		return -2
	}
	return sum / n
}
